| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Output** `output` | Corrected image | Corrected image, Fitted background, Inlier samples | The image with the background removed, the fitted surface as gray, or the image darkened with the grid samples that fit the surface marked in yellow. |
| **Degree** `degree` | 2 | 1 to 3 | The degree of the polynomial in x and y. 1 is a tilted plane, 2 can bend once, 3 twice. |
| **Inlier threshold** `threshold` | 10 | 1 to 100 levels | A sample is an inlier when its luma is within this distance of the surface. Our choice. |
| **Grid step** `step` | 8 | 2 to 64 px | The samples are the pixels of a grid with this spacing. Our choice. |
| **Trials** `trials` | 200 | 10 to 2000 | How many random samples RANSAC tries. The random seed is fixed, so the result repeats. Our choice. |
